title: Attribution precompute: writer query/rules changes invalidate job hashes; deploy together and update docs and snapshots
answers: I changed the sessions precompute writer query and cached attribution returns nothing
How to roll out changes to marketing attribution session precompute
Which files change together when altering cached attribution dimensions
body:
The writer query and project channel rules are part of the job hash, so changing either invalidates existing jobs. Rollout: deploy writer and reader together, warm fresh jobs, then enable the sessions-precomputation flag (reader stays off until validated).
Change together:
- writer and reader dimension logic in products/marketing_analytics/backend/hogql_queries/attribution_session_dimensions.py (live exception path and cached path must agree)
- SQL snapshots in products/marketing_analytics/backend/hogql_queries/__snapshots__/test_attribution_table_query_runner.ambr (the hogql_val_N parameter numbering shifts whenever the query shape changes)
- docs/internal/marketing-attribution-session-precompute.md
Queries with different channel rules than the writer's, or with project-timezone conversion disabled, still use the live path.
applies: Marketing analytics sessions-precompute writer/reader and its snapshot tests
